speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have multiple skin lesions; can you tell me how long they have been present and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum.

The history of daycare contact with a child with similar lesions and a brother with recent chickenpox (which likely did not cause these specific lesions) supports a viral etiology. Given the description of painless, non-pruritic papules in a child with potential exposure, Molluscum Contagiosum is the most likely diagnosis. Do you want me to request dermoscopic images of the lesions to confirm this?
